newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 POSTS FOURTH STRAIGHT GAIN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 POSTS FOURTH STRAIGHT GAIN.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index posted its fourth straight gain on Thursday but overall activity on the Prague bourse remained low.
The PX50 index closed up 0.95 percent to 509.1 while the major issue dominated RPIX rose 1.28 percent to 1,045.
However, turnover was just 641 million crowns with 734,000 shares traded.
The major issues continued to perform well with SPT Telecom rising 62 crowns to 2,972 and all other highly capitalised shares posting healthy gains.

Petrochemical stocks, Chemopetrol and Kaucuk, posted moderate gains after the boards of Unipetrol, Kaucuk, and Chemopetrol said they had agreed to swap one Chemopetrol share for between 1.05 to 1.20 Unipetrol shares, and one Kaucuk share for between 1.10 to 1.25 Unipetrol shares.
An exact ratio must still be approved by general shareholders meetings.
Chemopetrol rose nine crowns to 1,115 and Kaucuk rose eight crowns to 1,113.
Elswhere on the PX50, the majority of shares moved higher. The biggest gainer in the broader market was conference organiser BVV Brno which rose 160 crowns to 3,390.
